verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe deleting a user's entire memory scope via container tags ('When the user requests deletion, delete that container's content via the API / console workflow'), which covers per-entity/full erasure for privacy compliance. However, evidence never documents a single-memory delete endpoint/method, nor any confirmation flow, audit trail, or independent verification that deletion actually purges data (e.g., from backups/embeddings). missing for 10: single-memory-level delete API/example, confirmation of hard-delete semantics (vs soft-delete), independent/hands-on evidence of successful deletion, and audit/compliance documentation beyond container-tag erasure.
